title: Unified content reusable definitions — scoped source preparation, not frozen MCP protocol

R2_NaturalLocator.description: Natural source address. Office path uses expanded XML names and same-expanded-name sibling indices (0-based; root index 0). No raw XML prefix, server path, binary byte offset or IR ordinal.

R2_OfficePart.description: Validated package-relative part; no host/drive/UNC path, backslash, dot segment, empty segment or traversal. URI percent-decoding is not applied to this identity.

R2_DerivedPassageLocator.description: Derived parent address plus chunk index, never a native page/block address.

R2_SemanticParentRef.description: A passage cannot own children; semantic parents always have natural source locators.
